standard: llms.txt community specification (Answer.AI, September 2024) — robots.txt AI crawler directives

cases.why: robots.txt explicitly disallows GPTBot and ClaudeBot with Disallow: / — blockNamedCrawler() adds both to blockedAgents; AI_ROBOTS_CRAWLER_BLOCKED=true fires RULE_CRAWLER_BLOCKED

Catch-all User-agent: * with Disallow: / triggers blockAllCrawlers() — all 7 tracked AI crawlers (gptbot, claudebot, anthropic-ai, perplexitybot, google-extended, ccbot, bytespider) are added to blockedAgents
